Definition: from G3056 (in the commercial sense); a contribution:--collection, gathering.
BiblicalUsage: logía means a collection — a small word with a sharp edge. In 1 Corinthians 16:1, "Now concerning the collection for the saints"; and in 1 Corinthians 16:2, "that there be no gatherings when I come.".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the collection is worship with an order to it — every man laying by on the first day, so that when Paul comes there are no gatherings to be made in a hurry.
